stem: What happens next in this passage after “The bridge held more than students expected.”?
options: Teachers explained that outdoor learning still had goals: observation, language, movement, and cooperation.
The students learned that planning needs both simulation and observation.
The engineer explained that ancient builders learned from observation, failure, and experience.
The guide said ancient children played, learned, and made imperfect things too.

本文可直接核對「The bridge held more than students expected. The engineer explained that ancient builders learned from observation, failure, and experience.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The bridge held more than students expected. The engineer explained that ancient builders learned from observation, failure, and experience.」，答案為「The engineer explained that ancient builders learned from observation, failure, and experience.」。
